finding.text: `public/framework/ai/AISession/AISessionCoverage.js:111` (diff line 488) has lost its backslashes: `/^/|^[w./-]+.(md|js|mjs|jsonl)$/` and `.replace(/^public//, "")` are a SyntaxError (`node --check` fails at `^`). AISessionDetail imports this file, so every session page fails to load, and the "session page shows it" done-when is broken. The intended code was `/^\/|^[\w./-]+\.(md|js|mjs|jsonl)$/` and `/^public\//`.

Ask 4 is not done. In the session's `prompts.jsonl` every prompt's latest `parts` line is `step: "outcomes"`, and none is `step: "file"`. 31 parts are still `open`, 24 of them asks or rules. `session.jsonl` holds no task with a `source: {session…}`. So `--file` was never run, and the open asks of e00f55c9 are neither tasks nor written-down notes (`--summary`: 40 of 69 complete). One possible cause: the session record is `stop`ped by StaleClose (`session.jsonl` line 2), so filing onto it may be refused. Check that, then file the open asks or write them down.

The "task" outcomes in `--summary` (e.g. L7283 `task:5`) were written by the outcomes model, which pointed parts at tasks that already exist. They were not filed by this pipeline. A wrong `ref` therefore counts as settled once that task completes, so spot-check a few refs.

Prompt.js no longer sets `Prompt.View`; that now lives in `PromptView.js`. `Prompt.prototype.view` (Prompt.js `get view`) throws unless PromptView.js was imported first. RefineDemo imports it. `ai/SystemClasses.js`, `RefineSystem.js` and `test/session-log.mjs` import only Prompt.js, so check that none of them reads `.view`.

`prompts.jsonl` for e00f55c9 is 1.4 MB. That is the raw prompts plus two full `parts` lines per prompt, since each later step rewrites the whole list. It is acceptable, but every further step adds about 0.5 MB. A step could write only the outcomes it changed, keyed by part id.
`Servex/agents/PromptTasks.js:337` has a stray double block, `{ { const t = …; } }`. It is harmless and can be tidied.

The design side is sound and simpler than what it replaces. The blind parts step plus windowed outcomes is justified by the measured experiment (doc table: recall 0.95–1.0 at $0.16–0.29 versus about $2 for b and c). Completion is computed in one class shared by node and the browser. Both test files pass: prompt-records 10/10, prompt-tasks 22.
